prompt: Order the lifecycle of a milestone.
explanation: A milestone ages well only in this order: define the target, commit the work to it, burn it down while watching progress, then close it out — open issues left behind are a planning signal, not an error.

options.text: Create the milestone with a due date and description
Attach the issues and pull requests that must land
Close the tracked work as pull requests merge
Watch the milestone progress as items complete
Close the milestone when the goal date arrives
